Name: Skinny Animals - Push through faster
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]Farm animals won't block your way anymore!

Customize the delay before you run through your animals, or just ignore collision!

*Does not actually make your farm animals visually skinny[/size][/b]

[size=3]If you're doing the cheesey method of putting up fence posts on grass to grow self-sustaining grass, you might find that you don't have as much room to run around in your animal pens.

In fact, you might end up bumping shoulder to shoulder with all your animals as you make your way to collect eggs from the coop.

Well, worry no more because now you can plow right past your animals, saving you a precious extra 10 minutes of your day!

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Only makes client-side changes, so it will only affect those who have it installed.
[/size]
